item_name: Sabre Pepper Spray Gel Jogger - Special Formula P-22J-OC-US
item_short_desc: Sabre Jogger Pepper Gel is ideal for runners, athletes, and people on the go. Legal for sale in 50 States. NY, MA and HI require FFL for purchase.
description: Sabre Jogger Pepper Gel is ideal for runners, athletes, and people on the go. The gel formula is designed for maximum stopping power while decreasing wind blow-back and effects on bystanders. A convenient adjustable wrist strap wraps around the hand or wrist for jogging, while safety lock prevents accidental discharge. Sabre's Jogger Pepper Gel has approximately 35 shots, a range of 12 feet and a 4-year shelf life.
